data.body: Requirement from a separate in-flight epic (verification-status workflow, descended from bug 3c53-5ae3-6825-4c0b): the reparent command MUST support **unparenting** — i.e., transitioning a ticket's parent_id from a real parent to no parent. The downstream epic needs this so that when a parent epic is blocked from closing because a child bug is in the new `in_review` status, the operator can sever the parent-child link rather than leave the parent stuck or force-close it. Either accept a sentinel target like `ticket reparent <id> none` / `ticket reparent <id> --unparent`, or expose a dedicated `ticket unparent <id>` alias — both shapes are acceptable, but the unparent semantic must be reachable through the CLI. Please consider this when this epic is brainstormed.
